newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on money claims, launch new issue.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on money claims, launch new issue.

text.p: The Swiss federal government set a yield of 1.602 percent on its latest series 3.385 of three-month money market claims, and announced a new series 3.386 of three-month claims.
The latest allocation follows the conclusion of the auction on May 6. Settlement is May 9. The 3.385 series was priced at 99.601 percent, with an allocation of 1.077 billion francs.
The government also announced the new series of three-month claims which will be auctioned May 13 and paid for May 15. The series matures on August 14.
